Package com.saicone.types.util

Class WrappedDeque<A,B>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.types.util.WrappedObject<A,B>
com.saicone.types.util.WrappedCollection<A,B>
com.saicone.types.util.WrappedQueue<A,B>
com.saicone.types.util.WrappedDeque<A,B>
Type Parameters:
A - the base type of object.
B - the type of object to represent A.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<B>, Collection<B>, Deque<B>, Queue<B>, SequencedCollection<B>
public class WrappedDeque<A,B> extends WrappedQueue<A,B> implements Deque<B>
Represents a Deque of type A as a Deque of type B.
